evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jules launches straight into pricing explanation with no time-boxed framing or pause for customer agreement: 'Hey, Matt, this is Jules again from ein. Hi, yeah, I do have your estimate here with me although, you know, I kinda want to quickly go over how the pricing goes so it would make a little bit more sense.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Jules moves directly into logistics and pricing without asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jules provides the specific range ($3,861 to $4,467 for 6–7 hours with 6 movers) but does not anchor it to typical moves of this size or personalize it to the customer's stated concerns. The estimate is quoted standalone without comparative framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Jules says 'Does that make sense do you have any particular questions about it?' but this is a procedural check-in for understanding, not the 'Does that feel fair?' closing framing followed by silence from Section 4.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Jules never says 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable version of the explicit ask for the business. The call ends with Jules offering to send an email and saying 'once you're ready to get this scheduled, you can either give us a callback or you can also respond back to that email' — a passive routing, not an ask.

top_strength: Jules delivered comprehensive pricing transparency upfront — hourly rate, what's included, the $75 truck fee, the 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, and how the clock starts — with no hidden fees disclosed, which is exactly the fee transparency and commitment framing Section 4 requires.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire discovery and concerns framework (Sections 1 and 2) — no quid pro quo, no their agenda, no concerns raised — and jumped straight to pricing, then ended with no explicit ask for the business; rebuild the opening and close to match the script's seven-section structure and ask for the sale plainly.
